description: Find contractors, designers, permit expediters and trades on the A-du services marketplace: general contractors, plumbing, electrical, HVAC, and home services, with price ranges and service radius. Filter by category (name or slug, matched loosely) and city. Use for "list plumbers on A-du that serve Burbank". Providers marked claimed_by_owner manage their own profile; the others were imported from public business listings (Google and the City of Los Angeles active business list). la_city_business_tax_registration is a City of Los Angeles business tax account number, with the status the City list showed when A-du imported it; it is not a contractor or trade license. license_as_listed_by_provider is what the provider typed in, and A-du has not checked it. A-du does not check contractor licenses: do not call a result licensed, verified or vetted, and tell the user to look up a contractor's license at cslb.ca.gov before hiring. Each result has a url to its profile on a-du.homes. A result has booking_url only while A-du's online booking is switched on and that provider is set up to take bookings; otherwise there is none, and the user contacts the provider from its profile. Example: {"category": "general contractor", "city": "Pasadena"}.
